module_summary: pad.cpp is the menu's controller layer: a PadManager class (include/padmanager.h) with one static instance that opens libpad ports, polls pads each frame with bounded waits, merges the left stick into the d-pad, runs per-button repeat timers, keeps the DualShock ANALOG lock, drives the menu rumble pulse (native and PADEMU DS3/DS4) and keeps debug-HUD fault counters; the pad.h free functions forward to it. sfx.cpp holds the SoundEffects class (theme or built-in ADPCM one-shots, rotating cursor channels, per-press RPC timing, rumble-on-sound), sound.cpp the audsrv bring-up and volumes, sound.h the shared audio API. settings.cpp is a constexpr table that defaults, loads and saves the plain CONFIG_OPL_* keys plus per-video-mode screen positions. riptlite.h/riptlite.cpp define the LITE_HAS_* gates and the device mask for single-device RiptOPLite builds. vmc_groups.h only declares getGroupIdForTitleId (defined in src/core/vmc_groups.cpp).

reusable_helpers.name: settingsLoad/settingsSave/settingsApplyDefaults
reusable_helpers.what: table-driven int/string/colour config key default, load and save over config_set_t

reusable_helpers.name: SoundEffects::readFile
reusable_helpers.what: reads a whole file (theme tar first, then open/lseek/memalign/read) into a 64-byte aligned heap buffer

reusable_helpers.what: snapshot and restore a fixed list of config keys around a config save

reusable_helpers.name: PadManager::pollElapsedMs
reusable_helpers.what: wrap-safe milliseconds since last call from cpu_ticks() with sub-ms carry

findings.title: sfxGetDropDiag is a stub that always reports 0/0; the debug HUD's SX field and six include comments describe counters that no longer exist
findings.problem: sfxGetDropDiag writes 0 to both outputs; the dispatch ring and stale/full counters it describes (sound.h:26-27, 'see the counters' comment in sound.c') are gone. Its only caller is guioverlay.cpp:203, which prints the zeros as 'SX%u/%u' and documents them at :196-201. Six files carry an include comment naming the drop counters; only guioverlay.cpp calls either diag.
findings.fix: Delete sfxGetDropDiag and its prototype, drop sxStale/sxFull and the SX%u/%u field from the HUD string and its comment lines, and shorten the six include comments to what is actually used (sfxPlay etc.).
findings.benefit: ~14 lines removed and a misleading always-zero HUD value gone; a few dozen bytes of .text and format string (INFERRED: the stub is called, so it is linked)
findings.evidence: Grep sfxGetDropDiag over src/RiptOPL (all file types): sfx.cpp:305 (definition), sound.h:28 (prototype), guioverlay.cpp:203 (only call), plus include comments in gui.cpp:29, guigameid.cpp:35, guimodal.cpp:23, guioverlay.cpp:19, guiwait.cpp:22, guisettings.cpp:33. Grep sxStale|sxFull: only guioverlay.cpp:202,203,213. sfxGetPlayDiag is called only at guioverlay.cpp:204. No .github test references sfxGetDropDiag.

findings.title: pad.h and sound.h sfx* functions are pure forwarders to a single static PadManager / SoundEffects instance
findings.problem: Sixteen pad.h functions (pad.cpp:1244-1322) and four sfx* functions (sfx.cpp:421-439) only call the same-named method on one file-static object (gPads, gSfx); no other instance or caller of the classes exists. unloadPads goes through two forwarders (unloadPads -> PadManager::unload -> unloadEx(0)). The build already inlines the members into the wrappers: the linker map lists the out-of-line PadManager copies as discarded, so the layer is source weight only.
findings.fix: Keep one API: either make the methods the pad.h/sound.h functions over file-static state (the shape before the class conversion), or let the few callers use the object directly. At minimum delete PadManager::unload and call unloadEx(0) from unloadPads.
findings.benefit: ~100 source lines (wrappers ~105, public class declarations ~35, offset by moving state to file statics); no ELF change, MEASURED: riptopl-discarded-firstparty.txt shows the out-of-line PadManager members already removed by --gc-sections
findings.evidence: Read pad.cpp:1240-1322, sfx.cpp:417-439, padmanager.h, soundeffects.h. Grep PadManager|SoundEffects over the repo: only pad.cpp, sfx.cpp, the two headers, docs/CPP-CONVERSION-PLAN.md:389 (states the free functions 'forward to it') and five .github/scripts source-text tests (test_pad_repeat_clock.py etc., which would need their extraction patterns updated). evidence/RiptOPL/raw/riptopl-discarded-firstparty.txt lists 20 .text._ZN10PadManager* sections of pad.o as discarded (1,564 bytes, BUILD-EVIDENCE.md:231).

findings.title: Unused macros in riptlite.h: LITE_DEVICE_NAME (8 definitions), LITE_HAS_TCPIP, and LITE_HAS_NBD which only feeds LITE_HAS_TCPIP
findings.problem: LITE_DEVICE_NAME is defined once per device and never read; LITE_HAS_TCPIP is never tested; LITE_HAS_NBD appears only inside the LITE_HAS_TCPIP definition. Nothing in src, include, tools or .github/scripts names any of them outside riptlite.h.
findings.fix: Delete the eight LITE_DEVICE_NAME lines, LITE_HAS_TCPIP with its comment, and both LITE_HAS_NBD definitions with their comment.
findings.benefit: ~14 header lines; no ELF change (preprocessor only, INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Grep 'LITE_(DEVICE_NAME|HAS_[A-Z_0-9]+)' over the whole repo excluding riptlite.h: uses only of LITE_HAS_USB/MX4SIO/ILINK/BDMHDD/DVR/APA/MMCE_GAMES/SMB/UDPBD/UDPFS/BDM/NFS/NET_SOURCE/SMB_SHARE (opl.cpp, riptlite.cpp, dialogs.cpp, guisettings.cpp, ethsupport, hddsupport, udpfssupport, test scripts). LITE_DEVICE_NAME, LITE_HAS_TCPIP, LITE_HAS_NBD: no match outside riptlite.h; inside it LITE_HAS_NBD is used only at :113. Script lead symbols-unreferenced.tsv agrees for LITE_DEVICE_NAME and LITE_HAS_TCPIP.

findings.title: pad.cpp in-file duplication: two identical deadzone switches, the actAlign setup twice, and two copies of the pulse-arm assignments in rumble()
findings.problem: readLeftJoy has two 16-line switches mapping gXSensitivity and gYSensitivity to the same {128,100,80,60} deadzones (default 100). initialize() and rumbleRealign() fill actAlign[0..5] with the same six assignments. rumble() sets rumbleStartTicks_, rumbleDurTicks_ and rumbleLarge_ in both the active and the new-pulse branch.
findings.fix: Use one static const deadzone table indexed by the clamped setting for both axes; let initialize() set the alignment through the same few lines rumbleRealign uses (or a 6-byte static const array copied with memcpy); in rumble() assign start, duration and level once and keep only the branch-specific repeat/active updates.
findings.benefit: ~38 lines removed (switches 33 -> ~4, actAlign 6, rumble ~5); negligible .text change (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read pad.cpp:279-284, 317-349, 613-618, 736-752. The two switches differ only in the variable names; the actAlign blocks are byte-for-byte identical apart from comments. In rumble(), rumbleOffRepeats_ = 0 is harmless on the active path because rumbleFlush (the only setter of a nonzero value, :704) also clears rumbleActive_.

findings.title: PadManager::initialize always returns 1, so startOne's failure check is dead
findings.problem: Every return in initialize() (lines 209, 235, 248, 256, 296) returns 1. Its two callers are startOne (1144-1146, 'if (!initialize(pad)) return 0;', never taken) and read() at 943, which ignores the value.
findings.fix: Make initialize() void and delete the check in startOne.
findings.benefit: ~3 lines; compiler likely folds the check already (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read pad.cpp:188-297 (all five returns are 'return 1'). Grep 'initialize(' in pad.cpp: definition :188, calls :943 (value unused) and :1144. padmanager.h:62 is the private declaration; no other caller (private member).

findings.title: Stale and orphan comments in pad.cpp/padmanager.h left from the C-to-class conversion
findings.problem: pad.cpp:34 and :71-77 are comments for variables that now live in padmanager.h (the 'Declared up here' text declares nothing). :47 names gPadReadyEmptyRun, which no longer exists (it is maxEmptyRun_). :581 says initialize() has five bail-outs, :596 correctly says four. :641, :713, padmanager.h:25-26 and gui.cpp:308 refer to padRumbleRealign, pad.c and readPads instead of rumbleRealign, pad.cpp and read().
findings.fix: Delete pad.cpp:34 and :71-77; correct the names and the bail-out count in the others.
findings.benefit: ~8 lines removed, comments match the code; no ELF change
findings.evidence: Grep gPadReadyEmptyRun over repo: only the comment at pad.cpp:47. padmanager.h:78-79 and :92 carry the comments for elapsedMs_ and the rumble state. Counted returns above padSetActAlign in initialize(): :209, :235, :248, :256 (four). Grep 'padRumbleRealign' finds only comments (pad.cpp:641, padmanager.h:25); function is PadManager::rumbleRealign (:589).

findings.title: Unused includes and stale 'Theme Sound Effects' banners in sound.cpp and sfx.cpp
findings.problem: After the split into sound.cpp/sfx.cpp/bgm.cpp, sound.cpp still includes timer.h, vorbis/vorbisfile.h, delaythread.h, themes.h and pad.h and uses none of them (only audsrv, LOG, the bgm flags and volume globals); sfx.cpp includes vorbisfile.h and delaythread.h without using Ogg or DelayThread. sound.cpp:19-20 heads gAudioInitialized with a 'Theme Sound Effects' banner, duplicated at sfx.cpp:21-22 above a one-line comment that says the same; sfx.cpp:50-52 are blank.
findings.fix: Delete the seven unused includes, the banner in sound.cpp, one of the two in sfx.cpp, and the blank lines.
findings.benefit: ~12 lines; faster compile (vorbisfile.h pulls in the codec headers); no ELF change (INFERRED)
findings.evidence: Read sound.cpp 1-72 and sfx.cpp 1-439 in full: no ov_/OggVorbis, DelayThread, thm*, pad* call in sound.cpp and no cpu_ticks there; sfx.cpp uses cpu_ticks (timer.h), thmGetGuiValue (themes.h), tar*, padRumble, but no DelayThread or vorbis. LOG comes from include/ioman.h:77-80. Not compiled to confirm (Med confidence on include removal).

findings.title: settings.cpp: two adjacent #ifdef RETROACHIEVEMENTS blocks, stale file references, and screenPosStore/screenPosRecall exported but file-local
findings.problem: Lines 66-67 close and reopen the same #ifdef RETROACHIEVEMENTS. The header comment says the special-case load/save code stays in opl.cpp; it is in src/app/settingsio.cpp (settingsLoad at :1571, settingsSave at :2223). settings.h:7 and opl.cpp:1485 point to src/settings.cpp (the file is src/core/settings.cpp). screenPosStore and screenPosRecall are called only inside settings.cpp but are declared in opl.h.
findings.fix: Merge the two #ifdef blocks, correct the file names in the comments, make screenPosStore/screenPosRecall static and drop their opl.h prototypes.
findings.evidence: Grep 'screenPos(Store|Recall|...)' over repo: screenPosStore only at settings.cpp:257 (def), :309 (call), opl.h:430; screenPosRecall only at settings.cpp:267, :291, :304, opl.h:431; .github/scripts/test_screen_pos_per_mode.py names only ModeChanged/Load/Save/Reset. Grep settingsLoad/settingsSave: callers in src/app/settingsio.cpp only. SCREEN_POS_MODES 20 was checked and matches the 20 vmodeNames (guisettings.cpp:2607-2616), so it is not reported.

findings.title: Half-rate tick constant 147456 defined twice (pad.cpp, sfx.cpp) with the same rationale comment; rumble timing rationale repeated in sfx.cpp
findings.problem: CLOCKS_PER_MILISEC (pad.cpp:28) and SFX_CLOCKS_PER_MS (sfx.cpp:271) are the same deliberate half-rate value with near-identical explanations. sfx.cpp:320-324 repeats the 35 ms / ERM spin-up rationale already given at :276-279.
findings.fix: Define the half-rate constant once in a shared header next to pad.h's API (or have sfx.cpp use pad.cpp's) and keep one explanation; delete the repeated rumble paragraph in sfxRumble.
findings.evidence: Grep '147456|CLOCKS_PER_MILISEC|SFX_CLOCKS_PER_MS' over *.c,*.cpp,*.h: only pad.cpp:28 and sfx.cpp:271 define it (sfx.cpp:268 comment cites pad.cpp's). The ee_core 294912 constants are a separate program and not included.
